en: A state that is neither a cause (*na-hetu*) nor grasped and subject to clinging (*anupādinnupādāniya*) is a condition, by way of object-condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), for a state that is a cause and grasped and subject to clinging.
A state that is neither a cause nor grasped and subject to clinging is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is not a cause but is grasped and subject to clinging.
A state that is neither a cause nor grasped and subject to clinging [is a condition] for a state that is a cause and grasped and subject to clinging...

And a state that is neither-root nor acquired-and-liable-to-clinging is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a state that is neither-root but acquired-and-liable-to-clinging. ... Three [instances].

Both a state that is neither-root nor acquired-and-liable-to-clinging and a state that is neither-root but not acquired-and-liable-to-clinging are conditions, by way of object-condition, for a state that is root but acquired-and-liable-to-clinging.
Dhamma is related to dhamma by object-condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*) ... three. With respect to object, proximity, contiguity, decisive support, there are nine;

with respect to prenascence, three; with respect to kamma, three; with respect to nutriment, one; with respect to presence, three; with respect to absence and disappearance, nine; with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Conditioned by a state that is not-root, not-clung-to, but subject-to-clinging (*na-hetu na-anupādinnupādāniya*), a state that is root and subject-to-clinging (*hetu anupādinnupādāniya*) arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. With respect to root, three; with respect to predominance, three ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, three.

Conditioned by a state that is not a root, not grasped, and not subject to clinging, there arises a state that is a root, not grasped, and not subject to clinging, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. There are three [results] under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
